2. Protobuf serialize
tag1/type0 = 0x0A
len9 = 0x09
'uuid-1234' UTF-8 = 9B
total 11B

3-4. gRPC + HTTP/2 framing
flag0 = 0x00, len11 = 0x0000000B -> 16B frame
+9B hdr: len16 3B, DATA 0x00
END_STREAM 0x01, StreamID1 4B -> 25B wire
